claims.claim: Great condition with powerful clean sound.
claims.evidence: Photos show the speakers physically, but no audio test, no distortion/volume verification, and no functional indicators beyond a blue light on one unit.

claims.claim: Can be used with your laptop or other devices for good.
claims.evidence: No visible ports/connectivity details (Bluetooth/AUX/USB) and no pairing/connection proof in the photos.

risks.risk: Speakers may be faulty or degraded (no sound, weak bass, distortion, blown driver) even if they look intact.
risks.proof: A short audio test clip: play the same track from a phone/laptop through the speakers at low, medium, and high volume, showing both channels clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed working (worst case: possible driver issues) until an audio test is provided.

risks.risk: Power/adapter compatibility may be missing or incorrect (wrong voltage, missing cable), preventing use.
risks.proof: Photo of the exact power input/label requirements plus a clear shot of the included adapter/cable (model/voltage) and a quick power-on demonstration.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may require buying the correct adapter/cable.

risks.risk: Connectivity may not match what you need (Bluetooth not pairing, AUX/USB not working, controls not responsive).
risks.proof: Video showing the connection method in use (e.g., Bluetooth pairing screen or AUX/USB plugged in) and a working control action (volume/track) with the blue light behavior matching.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as connectivity not guaranteed; assume only basic/unknown input works.

risks.risk: Cosmetic/structural damage not fully visible (cracks, loose driver mounts, worn surrounds) could affect value.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both drivers’ surrounds and speaker edges/corners from multiple angles, plus a shot of the back panel/ports area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst visible condition (no extra discount for assumed perfect cosmetics).

proof_requests: Record a 30–60 second audio test (same track) showing both speakers producing sound clearly at low/medium/high volume.
Show the exact power input and include the adapter/cable (with voltage/model visible), then demonstrate power-on.
Show how you connect to a laptop/phone (Bluetooth pairing or AUX/USB) and demonstrate volume/control working.
Provide close-up photos of both drivers (including the surround edges) and any ports/back panel details.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item type and brand/model from the photos (two desktop speakers, logi, Model S-0010 2207 Right/Left). However, functionality and connectivity are not verifiable from images, so it should be priced at the worst-case working uncertainty until proof is provided.
